description: Adds a question to a person's plan page on shurco.ai, in their name. Alexey Shurov is told and replies on the page. Use it only when the person has agreed to the exact question. It needs their own link.

link.description: The person's private link to their plan page, as they pasted it.

question.description: The question, in the person's words.
